$Comment: The Horseman's Breastplate, one of the four plain pieces of his armour the Horseman's Hoard can pay, the Claim players see as his Boss Kill (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json and its hard twin): the black steel he rides in, still warm. A member of the Hallowed set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json). Its model is the Horseman's own chest cut for a player: tools/derive_art.py takes the collar chest he wears (Items/Hallows_Eve/Horseman_Armor/), cuts away the high collar that fills his headless neck and the cape that hangs to his heels, and writes the rest to Items/Hallows_Eve/Horseman_Breastplate/, worn here in the plain texture and drawn into its icon by the same tool. Its recipe is left out (it is never crafted) and its stats sit a step below the iron breastplate's, the way the Jack Helm sits below the iron helm, with one thing more: DamageBonus_Fire, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Fire damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so a Lantern Bomb or any fire weapon hits 3% harder with it on. Its flaming twin, Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Horseman_Breastplate, is the Hoard's stronger copy, the same chest in gold. Light is the ember glow it gives off. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent. Tags.ZigLevel asks for Defense 20 to wear it (the best level the player ever reached), behind MMO Skill Tree's Gear levels switch (Tags.ZigLevelFeature); gear a player already had when gear levels arrived keeps working for them, and a server owner frees or retunes it with a ZigLevel group gate in mods/ziggfreedcommon/use-gates.json.
